summary_md: **Pramod Menasi ([@Pramod_b_m](https://x.com/Pramod_b_m/status/2115354428555534701))** released **siftwise v0.2**: it now runs on GitLab CI, is tested with five coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Gemini) and supports flaky-test re-runs for Go, Jest and Java; the dev.to guide covers setup.
